mandate_interpretation.return_hurdle: 5% is a non-guaranteed research hurdle. It is not a promise, forecast, or suitability conclusion.
mandate_interpretation.cash_distribution_treatment: Issuer distributions are examined as security facts and return components only. This track has no retained-cash or reinvestment objective.
mandate_interpretation.scope: Personally accessible domestic direct A-share research, with no leverage, short exposure, derivatives, brokerage action, or order execution.

direct_equity_answer.conclusion: Direct equities should not be excluded from a broad domestic-universe research process. They remain a distinct quality, valuation and distribution route, but the observed C10 basket cannot be admitted as a strategy that meets the strict 5% annual condition.
what_this_does_not_claim: The four names are not the best available A shares.
The four-name basket is not an approved allocation or an action instruction.
A reported distribution, trailing earnings multiple, volume field, or past return does not establish a future return or an executable fill.

strict_return_gate.criterion: Every complete calendar year and every complete rolling five-year annualized endpoint must be at or above 5% after all relevant investor-level effects.
strict_return_gate.why_rolling_five_year_is_not_adjudicated: Only four complete calendar years are represented, the security set was selected after those observations, and SSE raw closes plus gross distribution events are not a point-in-time investor total-return and execution ledger.

negative_evidence.diagnostic_definition: For arithmetic only, fixed research weights are reset at each prior calendar-year close. Each component result equals (year-end raw SSE close + gross cash distributions with ex-dates in the year) / prior year-end raw SSE close - 1.
negative_evidence.interpretation: The two sub-5% years are adverse evidence against this exact ex-post basket. They are not a proof that no possible equity rule can ever satisfy the hurdle.
non_waivable_limits: The SSE price response is retrospective and its adjustment basis is not disclosed.
The event query is not a complete entitlement, payment, tax or corporate-action ledger.
No bid/ask, depth, suspension history, broker fee, tax, fill, settlement or account record is included.
The candidate was chosen after the observed interval, so even positive observations would not validate a prospective rule.

fixed_diligence_basket.status: bounded research basket only; no allocation approval
fixed_diligence_basket.selection_basis: Four SSE issuers from distinct business buckets were selected solely so every component can receive issuer-level primary-source diligence. This is not a current all-A-share screen.
fixed_diligence_basket.weight_policy: The weights are frozen for the historical diagnostic and paper protocol. They are not optimized, individually suitable, or a direction to establish positions.

frozen_future_paper_protocol.status: not activated; it becomes a prospective paper protocol only after the data and market-access gates below are closed
frozen_future_paper_protocol.intended_universe: All ordinary A shares listed on the Shanghai and Shenzhen exchanges that have the required five completed fiscal years, point-in-time membership/status history and issuer filings. C10 does not possess that full universe or Shenzhen trading-rule evidence, so it cannot represent this as a completed screen.
selection_rules_to_run_on_the_frozen_uni: Exclude a name if it lacks five completed fiscal years, has a risk-warning/delisting-warning flag or suspension at the screen timestamp, or lacks a timely audited annual report.
Require a standard unqualified audit opinion and three consecutive completed years of positive attributable profit.

For non-financial issuers, require positive operating cash flow in each of those three years. For banks, do not use operating cash flow as a cash-conversion substitute; instead require a reported non-performing-loan ratio no greater than 1.5% and a reported common-equity Tier 1 capital ratio of at least 10.0%. These are frozen research thresholds, not regulatory minima or safety guarantees.
Require at least three actual cash-distribution events in the preceding five completed fiscal years after corporate-action and entitlement reconciliation.
Require a screen-date trailing reported-EPS price multiple no greater than 22.5x, calculated only from records that were available at that timestamp.

Limit to one issuer in each of four business buckets and cap a name at 30% of the research basket. The currently researched buckets are spirits, hydroelectric utility, commercial banking and integrated coal/power/transport.
frozen_future_paper_protocol.current_basket_relation_to_rules: The names were researched before an eligible full-universe, point-in-time run exists. They therefore cannot be certified as rule-selected or ranked against the intended universe.

review_and_rebalance_calendar.annual_review: First exchange trading day after 30 April, after every candidate's annual report and required universe/status data have been archived and frozen.
review_and_rebalance_calendar.interim_review: First exchange trading day after 31 August, after every candidate's interim report and required event/status data have been archived.
review_and_rebalance_calendar.reconstitution_rule: If a name fails a frozen eligibility rule, change its research status to not-actionable and conduct a documented universe re-screen. No automatic substitute and no automatic external transaction are permitted.
review_and_rebalance_calendar.price_rule: There is deliberately no price-only stop or take-profit rule. Such a rule is not validated by this source set.

SSE_mechanics_for_a_future_paper_executi.permitted_paper_record_window: For a normal SSE A-share, record a hypothetical change only during continuous auction 09:30-11:30 or 13:00-14:57 on an exchange trading day. Do not use the no-cancellation intervals 09:20-09:25 or 14:57-15:00 as a paper fill assumption.
SSE_mechanics_for_a_future_paper_executi.price_and_lot_controls: Limit price only; verify the security's live price-limit status; use the RMB0.01 minimum price increment and 100-share buy-lot rule stated in the exchange rules.
SSE_mechanics_for_a_future_paper_executi.settlement_control: Do not assume a same-day resale right for A shares. The exchange rule states that purchased securities may not be sold before settlement except for the enumerated T+0 classes; A shares are not listed among those exceptions.
blocking_conditions: No contemporaneous exchange status, live quote, bid/ask, depth, account-permission, broker-fee, tax or settlement evidence.
Suspension, risk-warning/delisting-warning condition, special price-limit condition, or a discrepancy in code/security identity.
Any missing audit, corporate-action, price-adjustment or point-in-time availability field needed to reconstruct the candidate's result.
SSE_mechanics_for_a_future_paper_executi.boundary: These are controls for a future paper record, not instructions to submit an order.

admission_gates_still_open: A complete point-in-time A-share universe with listing, suspension, risk-warning and delisting history.
A point-in-time adjusted total-return and corporate-action/entitlement dataset sufficient to calculate all investor-level effects for at least five rolling years.
A pre-registered selection date, holdout period and independent replication; the current basket is ex post.
Contemporaneous code-level market-status, bid/ask/depth and transaction-cost records, plus account and broker eligibility verification.
A formal replay that passes the 5% hard gate after all documented taxes, fees, fills, settlement and corporate-action treatment.
